mapper.select:
select id topicId, `topic`, ctime, uptime, `status`, cuid, opuid, `content`, `pic_url` picUrl from corgi_topics where `status` != 'deleted'
and `status` = #{status}
and `topic` like concat('%',#{text},'%')
order by `order`
select id topicId, `topic`, ctime, uptime, `status`, cuid, opuid, `content`, `pic_url` picUrl from corgi_topics where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update corgi_topics set topic = #{topic.topic}, content = #{topic.content}, opuid = #{topic.opuid}, `status` = #{topic.status}, `pic_url` = #{topic.picUrl}, `url` = #{topic.url}, `url_type` = #{topic.urlType}, `order` = #{topic.order} where id = #{topic.topicId}
mapper.select: select content from corgi_activity_topic a left join corgi_topics t on t.id = a.topic where activity_id = #{activityId}

select t.id topicId, t.`topic`, t.ctime, t.uptime, t.`status`, t.cuid, t.opuid, t.`content`, t.`pic_url` picUrl from corgi_activity_topic a left join corgi_topics t on t.id = a.topic where activity_id = #{activityId}
